fact: The bill on the regime of access to and reuse of administrative documents and information was approved in committee (especialidade) on a Friday 1 April 2022, after approval in general on 10 March, to take effect 180 days after publication.
title: Proposta de Lei que estabelece o Regime de Acesso e Reutilização de Documentos e Informações Administrativas aprovada na especialidade
